# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the tasks you measurably broke/fixed, plus the ones whose move was too small to resolve) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — add pre-commit price-quote tool + all-reservations loop tool
- Changes I made:
  - NEW `get_reservation_price_change(reservation_id, cabin, flights)` (read/compute) — mirrors
    `update_reservation_flights` pricing exactly, returns amount_due/amount_refunded. Cluster: task 11
    COMMUNICATE (wrong refund number) + the whole "how much will this change cost" class.
  - NEW `list_reservations(user_id)` (loop) — returns full details of all a user's reservations in one
    call. Cluster: task 22 (agent modified the WRONG reservation because it couldn't see all routes).
  - Doc pointer on `update_reservation_flights` → use the quote tool; refund is vs PAID price, not fare.
- Expected effect + safety:
  - KEY finding: reward = DB × COMMUNICATE; action_checks are informational (passing 8/17/37 have
    action_match=False yet reward 1.0). Task 11's DB ALREADY matches (5244 refund applied); only the
    COMMUNICATE check for "5244" fails because the agent hand-computed $1,515 from market fares. The
    quote tool hands it the exact 5244 → flips 11 to 1.0. Verified body returns 5244 on trace args.
  - Both edits are NEW read-only tools; no existing tool body changed, so passing tasks 8/17/19/37 are
    unchanged by construction (BOUNDED). 16 tools total (<20).
- Building on prior RESULTS: none — iteration 1, no prior entries / rejected.jsonl empty.
- Refuted hypotheses: none yet.
- High-value clusters NOT cracked: stalls 25/40 (episode ends before any write turn — a composite tool
  can't fire; removing primitives is unbounded and regresses 8/17). Task 12 (over-budget→dropped free
  bags, NL-conditional). Task 23 (user-sim passenger data contradicts gold — not tool-fixable). Designs
  already reasoned-through and rejected for these are in PROCESS.md "Deliberately skipped".
- Plateau signal: n/a (first iteration). If this is rejected, the lever to try next is enriching the
  WRITE tools' return with an explicit charge/refund field (risk: re-read cost on passing 17/37) and/or
  a composite update-then-report tool — but the stall/data-mismatch tasks likely need agent-instruction
  (not tool) edits, which are out of this capability's scope.
- Focus next iteration: measure whether the quote tool alone moved val; if 22 didn't flip, the loop tool
  needs pairing with a route→airport city-match helper.
